Method of Attack: Missing authentication for critical function vulnerability (CWE-306)
Post-authentication privilege escalation via som/export handler
Attack Vector: Specially crafted requests to fgfmd daemon
Indicators of Compromise: Exfiltration of configuration data, IPs, credentials, and FortiOS256-hashed passwords
HTTP-based exfiltration to external IP addresses
Lag period between initial access and data exfiltration
